initial_budget_policy.policy: radial actual polygon area shares; initial shape preserved, standby independent fuel budgets

cells.geometry_basis: partition existing rectangular native boxes; preserve native vent spans, CAD center assigns receiving cell; virtual centers inverse-affine mapped to CAD for graph distances; not reconstructed polygon CFD

limits: centroid if inside; otherwise interior representative point; fire cell centre is fire position
physical openings assigned by CAD centre, whole aperture kept; crossing-aperture distribution is unresolved
disconnected pieces in one annulus share one zone state
full polygon perimeter uses existing wall/leakage model, including virtual interfaces; no new wall-loss model

graph.policy: Dijkstra, immediate adjacent parent; no L/v and no passage skipping
limits: one static shortest-delay route; actual heating times not part of path choice
closed-door penetration does not open native VENT; unclassified doors ordinary
passage sensor can trigger from incoming heat without local fire
cell distance in solver floor geometry; native rectangular partition is an approximation
